mapper.select: SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order WHERE update_time > #{updateTime} ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order WHERE rag_id = #{ragId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT id, rag_id, rag_name, knowledge_tag, status, version, file_hash, update_reason, create_time, update_time FROM ai_client_rag_order WHERE knowledge_tag = #{knowledgeTag} ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_client_rag_order SET rag_name = #{ragName}, knowledge_tag = #{knowledgeTag}, status = #{status}, version = #{version}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, update_reason = #{updateReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rag_id = #{ragId}
